title: Complete sales and purchase order traceability
description: Close the documented Phase-1 order gaps: enrich SalesOrder with foreign-trade contract/shipping fields and source quotation/PI traceability; enrich PurchaseOrder with customer/sales-order ownership and procurement execution/settlement fields. Update persistence, APIs, UI, import/export/print behavior and tests without changing production data.
acceptance_criteria: Sales orders support customer PO no, contract no, trade terms, destination port text, consignee, notify party, shipping marks, source quotation/PI, export mode, commission ratio, business nature, split-shipment flag, inspection requirements and packaging requirements.

Purchase orders support owning customer, owning sales order, advance-on-behalf flag, supplier confirmed delivery date, tax rate/tax-included mode, arrival progress, QC status, contract no and settlement progress.
Create/update/detail/list and relevant export/print paths preserve the new fields; existing records remain readable with safe defaults.
Web forms expose the fields with appropriate references/selects and can save/reload them in Microsoft Edge.
Schema upgrade is idempotent and verified only against NEWERP_TEST; production database remains untouched.
Tests cover new persistence/round-trip behavior and source linkage; existing build/unit/integration/UI tests remain green.
Real Edge acceptance verifies one sales order and one purchase order can save/reload the new fields without JS/API errors.

scenarios: Login in Microsoft Edge, create/edit a sales order, fill the new foreign-trade/source fields, save and reopen it to verify round-trip persistence.
Create/edit a purchase order, link it to customer and sales order, fill procurement execution fields, save and reopen it to verify persistence.
Open print/export or the relevant document preview and verify the added business fields do not break rendering or API calls.

human_gate.reason: User explicitly requested completion of all project functions. Schema changes are restricted to code and NEWERP_TEST validation; production deployment/database operations remain separately gated.
